SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Pathway Choices is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Pathway Choices as rumours only.
   B. Explain Pathway Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Pathway Choices never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Pathway Choices.

2. Which statement about Indigenous Knowledge Systems in African Societies Conservation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Explain Indigenous Knowledge Systems in African Societies Conservation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)

   B. Name the president

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
